name: ProgressSteps
description: A step indicator for multi-step flows such as wizards, onboarding sequences, or checkout. Renders an ordered list of steps with visual state (completed, current, upcoming) and connecting lines. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

notes: The root element is an <ol> (ordered list) to convey step sequence to screen readers.
The current step item has aria-current='step'.
Completed steps have a visible checkmark character inside the circle to convey state without relying on colour alone.
Step labels and optional descriptions are always visible as text.
The component is not interactive — it is display-only. Navigation is the responsibility of the parent.

steps.description: Ordered array of step descriptors. Each item must have a label; description is optional.

currentStep.description: Zero-based index of the active step. Steps before this index are 'completed'; this index is 'current'; steps after are 'upcoming'.

orientation.description: Layout direction. horizontal: steps arranged in a row. vertical: steps stacked with connecting line on the inline-start side.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root <ol> element.

do: Keep labels short (1–4 words) — long labels overflow in horizontal orientation.
Always set currentStep to the active step index so users know where they are.
Use vertical orientation when step labels are long or on narrow screens.
dont: Do not use ProgressSteps as a navigation component — use Tabs or a custom nav instead.
Do not skip step indices — currentStep must always match an index in the steps array.
Do not nest ProgressSteps inside another ProgressSteps.
